title: Independent public references
html:
Public records

Independent public references

These pages name me directly and add public context to experiences described elsewhere on this site. They are kept separate from general program information so the distinction is clear.

PECI Athletics · Junior boys rugby

A PECI Athletics post dated May 9, 2025 names me among the players recognized for great play after the junior boys defeated THS 33–5 while continuing an undefeated regular season.

View the original PECI Athletics post ↗

2026 Nancy Storrs Ontario Indoor Rowing Championships

The published race results list me with Brockville RC and record my 2,000-metre result at 7:53.0.

View the published rowing results ↗

Prince Edward County 4-H awards

A 2019 CountyLive report lists me among new 4-H members and among the members recognized in both the Maple Syrup Club and Pizza Club.
